usageNotes: Returns the firewall directory index for a specific LXC container on a PDM-managed PVE remote, listing the available firewall sub-resources (rules, ipsets, aliases, options, refs, log). Use this as a discovery call before drilling into a specific firewall sub-resource. The remote must be registered in PDM and the target PVE node must be reachable; vmid must refer to an existing LXC container, not a QEMU VM.

examples.summary: List firewall sub-resources for LXC 101 on the prod-hetzner remote

tips: The returned index is a directory listing only — it does not return actual firewall rules or settings; follow up with sub-resource endpoints (rules, options, etc.) for actionable data.
vmid must be an LXC container ID; using a QEMU VM ID here will return an error — use the equivalent /qemu/{vmid}/firewall path for VMs.
This endpoint requires no special privilege beyond authenticated access (user: all), so API tokens with minimal scope can enumerate firewall sub-resources.
